sec.title: August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 425)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio and Armed Forces transcription services, three archival transfers of Blake Edwards' hardboiled classic *The Big Foot Grafton Case* starring Dick Powell on *Richard Diamond, Private Detective* (1950 Network Master, West Coast Repeat, and 1953 AFRTS release), William Frawley in the sandlot baseball drama *Brannigan's Bat* on *Family Theater* (1950), Judy Canova's hillbilly musical comedy for Colgate (1947), and Olan Soule in *Runaway* on *Author's Playhouse* (1942–1953):
